name: my-film

song.name: any song generator or your own recording
song.notes: Generate or record the song anywhere, export mp3 or wav, save it as audio/song_master.mp3.

transcription.name: local whisper (analyze_song.py --words), or none
transcription.notes: Optional. Set mode to none to skip it and set string times by ear from the beat grid.

images.name: any image generator or hand-made art
images.notes: Save each keyframe as frames/k_<clip_id>.png at 1920x1080 or larger. Stills alone build a full animatic.

video.name: any image-to-video tool, or none
video.notes: Optional. Save clips as footage/final/<clip_id>_v1.mp4. Shots without a clip use their keyframe with a slow push-in.

_comments: Every key is optional except as noted in the README; missing keys take the defaults in common.py.

subject, consent, audience, off_limits and budget are metadata for the agent gates and reviewers; no script reads them except to check their types. consent.given stays false until the subject has agreed.
duration must equal the song's real length (within 0.25 s). allow_trim: true lets a LONGER song be cut to duration on purpose.
Sizes under `text` are reference values at 720p high and are scaled to the frame height. The defaults pass the 28 px minimum cap height with the Arial or DejaVu fallback.
providers is read for messages only. No script ever calls a provider. mode is one of mcp, cli, manual, none. Roles: song, transcription, images, video.
fonts: point at .ttf files you are licensed to use. Empty or missing falls back to a system font with a warning.
